retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait of a musician lounging on an ornate gold rococo sofa, blending luxury interior aesthetics with gritty urban fashion and rock instrumentation.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in urban attire and sunglasses reclines on a heavily carved, gold-leafed floral damask sofa. An electric guitar rests across their lap. The lighting is warm and moody, emphasizing metallic textures and deep shadows, with a bold typographic overlay across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of gritty urban fashion against 18th-century French luxury furniture
Horizontal alignment of the guitar neck with the central typographic baseline
Warm gold and brown tones contrasted by stark white and red display text
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's dominance and scale
coreInvariants: Ornate gold-framed sofa with floral damask upholstery
Electric guitar positioned horizontally across the subject's lap
Warm, low-key interior lighting with visible background bokeh

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and seated, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white electric guitar body and the large white display typography serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the guitar neck down to the right, then sweeps across the bold central text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with the sofa's texture and background details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gold and ochre tones from the sofa and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Stark white for the primary name and vibrant red for the secondary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/guitar and the dark, saturated background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with uniform stroke thickness
Custom elongated descenders on specific characters to create a 'fang' or 'spike' effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'Y' features a vertically extended stem that drops below the baseline into a sharp point.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast between a heavy white primary name and a spaced-out red secondary title.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom right corner

preserve: The sharp vertical extension on the central letter
The high-contrast color split between white and red

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric skeleton for the primary text.
Offers the sharp geometric terminals required for the look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person in urban streetwear and sunglasses reclining on a gold rococo sofa with floral patterns, holding a white electric guitar horizontally. Use warm, moody interior lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white geometric sans-serif text across the center, modifying the 'Y' to have a long pointed descender. Add a smaller, red, wide-tracked subtitle to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the 'Y' stem elongated and sharp?
Is the sofa gold and ornate?
Is the secondary text red and widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Branded logos on clothing or guitar

mustAchieve: High-quality metallic texture on the sofa

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the background
Ensure the gold textures look metallic rather than yellow
Verify the guitar does not look warped or AI-distorted
Confirm the 'fang' modification on the typography is present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Luxury Furniture] + [Urban Fashion] + [Musical Instrument] + [Geometric Typography with Sharp Modifications]
